description: Defines the SaltedSeedSeq template class which conforms to the C++ Seed Sequence concept, providing functionality to wrap and modify seed sequences with additional entropy, including methods for generating seed data, parameter extraction, and internal utility structures.

classes.name: SaltedSeedSeq
classes.description: A template class that wraps an existing seed sequence and modifies it by mixing in extra entropy, conforming to the C++ Seed Sequence concept.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Fills a range with seed data, mixing in salt material if the range is contiguous and of type uint32_t.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Extracts parameters from the seed sequence into an output iterator.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the seed sequence.
